Q8537.reason: A value-neutral definition keeps justification from being settled in advance by building a moral stance into the concept of punishment.

Q6097.reason: Most states treat a fee tail as a fee simple, so the cousin took the whole estate and the later deed to the niece conveyed nothing.

Q8324.reason: Chronic dopamine flooding downregulates postsynaptic receptors, so ordinary dopamine no longer registers and the patient is driven to seek more drug.
